arguments.text: 10 km, 8 legs of 1250 m out-and-back. Pacer owns effort. My jobs: (1) weed: sudden mid-leg drop of push_local (watch drag_jump) -> clear_rudder, check speed recovers; (2) pod drift: pod power vs boat power/HR diverging slowly (watches ratio_up/ratio_down, metric hr_per_pod) -> measure() early clean windows vs now, set pod_gain; (3) current/wind shift: note via legs(); (4) radio course change -> set_race_distance + tell distance; (5) speak rarely: reassure at halfway, tell distance late. Baseline: first clean legs after start.

arguments.reason: routine check after start settles; take baseline of pod/boat ratio, HR, push

arguments.text: min 4 (leg 1, north): pod 180 W (=pod CP), boat 121-123 W (CP 116), pod/boat ratio ~1.47 (CP ratio 1.55), HR 176 still rising slowly, push_local ~+0.1 northbound. Boat reserve 43% vs pod 58%: boat-side reads paddler above CP, pod reads at CP.

no cue: start settled, pacer near critical power; baseline noted.

arguments.text: min 6.3 end leg 1: pod 180 W steady (at pod CP) for 4 min, boat 122 W (above boat CP 116) -> boat reserve falls 2-3%/min while pod reserve flat 56%. HR 174->178 over 4 min (slow creep). Boat and pod calibrations disagree ~5%; HR trend is the tiebreak. Check after leg 2.

arguments.reason: end of leg 2: compare legs, HR trend, boat vs pod reserve disagreement

text: no cue: all steady; watching boat vs pod reserve disagreement.

arguments.text: Possible weed on rudder. One back-stroke to clear it.

min 9.5 leg 2 (south): GPS speed stepped down ~0.06 m/s at race ~510 s while pod rose 188->193; push_local stepped -0.05 -> -0.10. Paddler: effort 5/10, boat feels heavy, like something dragging. Sent clear_rudder at ~575 s. Check: speed back up after it = weed. Separately pod rose 178->193 over 5 min with HR only 176->180: possible pod drift up, unresolved.

arguments.reason: check clear_rudder result: did GPS speed recover vs pod power?

arguments.name: critical_power_boat_w
arguments.evidence: clean hull fit (legs 1-2, weed excluded) share 0.698 x pod CP 180 = 126 W; HR flat-ish (+0.2/min) at pod 186-191 for 4 min; paddler 4/10 plenty. Boat test 116 W equals only pod 166 W, too low vs these signs.

arguments.name: critical_power_pod_w
arguments.evidence: pre-race test 180; HR barely climbing at 186-191 suggests true CP may be higher; leg 1 at 179 HR +1.5/min (post-start)

arguments.name: weed
arguments.evidence: GPS speed fell 0.06 m/s at ~510 s at steady pod, paddler felt drag; after back-stroke speed 3.158 vs 3.088 at same pod 191 (+2.3%)

arguments.text: min 11: WEED CONFIRMED + CLEARED: clear_rudder at 574 s; GPS 3.088 (pod 192) during weed -> 3.158 (pod 191) after. Pod drift NOT supported: speed tracks pod rise 179->191 (fit share 0.698, push 0.07 along out). Current ~0.07 m/s helps northbound legs. Set boat CP 125 (was 116) to match pod CP x share; watch HR trend: if HR climbs >1 bpm/min at pod ~190, CP is lower, revise down.

arguments.message: push_local fell >0.05 mid-leg for 20 s: weed again (first weed was -0.06 m/s), wind, or pod?

arguments.text: 10 km, 8 legs of 1250 m out-and-back. Pacer owns effort. Done: weed at 510 s cleared by clear_rudder at 574 s (speed +2.3%). Boat CP set 125 W (test said 116; fit share 0.698 x pod CP 180). Current ~0.07 m/s helps northbound (odd legs). Watch: (1) weed again: drag_jump (push_local drop 0.05 mid-leg) -> ask_paddler then clear_rudder; (2) HR trend at pod ~190: if climbing >1 bpm/min, CP too high -> revise; (3) pod drift via ratio_up/ratio_down + HR; (4) radio course change -> set_race_distance + tell; (5) speak rarely; tell distance late.

arguments.reason: routine: HR trend vs pod power on leg 3, push symmetry, reserve

text: Confirmed weed cleared; corrected boat CP to 125 W.
no cue: weed cleared and confirmed by speed; boat critical power corrected to 125 W so the pacer does not ease needlessly.

arguments.text: min 12.7 RADIO: wind filling from the south 8-12 kn -> tailwind on northbound (odd) legs, headwind on southbound (even) legs, on top of current ~+0.07 north. Expect push_local north > +0.1, south < -0.1. A drag_jump alert on a south leg may be this wind, not weed: check whether it flips on the next leg and ask paddler before clear_rudder. Boat push_along lags -> boat power/reserve biased for a leg or two; pod reserve unaffected.
